mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_booking WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT b.id, b.booking_no AS bookingNo, b.venue_name AS venueName, b.court_name AS courtName, b.sport_name AS sportName, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS startAt, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.end_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS endAt, b.amount_fen AS amountFen, b.status, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.payment_expires_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS paymentExpiresAt, b.payment_status AS paymentStatus, r.status AS refundStatus FROM s_booking b LEFT JOIN s_refund r ON r.booking_id = b.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC

SELECT b.id, b.booking_no AS bookingNo, b.venue_name AS venueName, b.source, b.contact_name AS contactName, b.contact_phone AS contactPhone, b.court_name AS courtName, b.sport_name AS sportName, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS startAt, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.end_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS endAt, b.amount_fen AS amountFen, b.status, b.payment_status AS paymentStatus, b.venue_customer_id AS venueCustomerId FROM s_booking b WHERE b.venue_id = #{venueId} AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(b.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00')) = #{date} ORDER BY b.start_at, b.id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS reportDate, COUNT(*) AS bookingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effectiveBookingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'NO_SHOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS noShowCount, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW') THEN b.amount_fen ELSE 0 END) AS amountFen FROM s_booking b WHERE b.start_at >= #{startAt} AND b.start_at < #{endAt} AND b.venue_id = #{venueId} GROUP BY reportDate ORDER BY reportDate

SELECT b.booking_no AS bookingNo, b.venue_id AS venueId, b.venue_name AS venueName, b.court_name AS courtName, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS startAt, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.end_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS endAt, b.status, b.amount_fen AS amountFen, b.service_fee_rate_basis_points AS serviceFeeRateBasisPoints, v.service_fee_rate_basis_points AS currentServiceFeeRateBasisPoints FROM s_booking b JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = b.venue_id WHERE b.source = 'ONLINE' AND b.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW') AND b.service_fee_rate_basis_points > 0 AND b.end_at >= #{startAt} AND b.end_at < #{endAt} AND b.venue_id = #{venueId} ORDER BY b.venue_name, b.end_at, b.id
SELECT id FROM s_booking WHERE source = 'ONLINE' AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND payment_expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
SELECT id FROM s_booking WHERE source = 'ONLINE' AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND end_at < #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
SELECT id FROM s_booking WHERE source = 'OFFLINE' AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND end_at < #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
